_description: Saves API cost through smarter context management. Core features intact.

llm.notes: auto routes simple questions to Groq 8B (<$0.001), only complex tasks use expensive models

context.notes: Constitution is compressed to key rules only. Fewer history turns in context.

memory.notes: Sideagent verification skipped. FTS search disabled. Retrieval capped at 3 results.

mcp.notes: Tool schemas not injected. Agent calls describe_tool() only when needed.

avatar.notes: Avatar on but postFX and advanced lipsync disabled (GPU cost).

orchestrator.notes: No plan preview. No post-task critic. Faster but less verified.
